Criterion: Verify that the VCF can safely recover the air vehicle under a combination of worst-case flight envelope and engine failure conditions, and identify any flight limitations in the flight manual. Standard: The limits of the VCF are defined for a combination of worst-case flight envelope and engine failure conditions where the VCF can no longer guarantee safe recovery of the air vehicle. These limits define the safe envelope for the air vehicle and are identified in the flight manual. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, simulation, and review of documentation. The combinations of worst-case flight envelope and engine failure conditions are verified by analysis, simulation, SIL and FMET. Documentation review verifies that limitations are identified in the flight manual. References: JSSG-2008: 3.0, 3.1, 3.1.5, 3.1.5.3, 3.1.5.7, 3.1.5.8, 3.1.5.9, 3.1.9, 3.1.14, 3.2.1.3, 3.2.1.2, 3.2.2.2, 3.2.2.5, 3.2.2.5.4, 3.2.2.6, 3.3, associated section 4 paragraphs. 14 CFR 23.141-23.253, 25.21-25.255, 23.321-23.459, 25.321-25.459, 23.1501- 23.1529, 25.1501-25.1529.
